items.desc: Downloads a Bilibili video with yt-dlp, samples key frames, and transcribes it — from the site subtitles, or from a local faster-whisper install when there are none. items.name: travelplanner

Ships 9 skills, an environment doctor that walks users through missing API keys, and a patch for the 12306 MCP server; it plans and queries but never books or pays.

items.name: dsh-connectors#desktop-connector
items.desc: Windows desktop control connector: through 10 agent tools it captures the screen (including occluded and partially off-screen windows), lists and focuses windows, moves, clicks, drags and scrolls the mouse, and sends key chords or arbitrary Unicode text. Built on koffi FFI: no compiler, no per-call subprocess, and its own GDI screenshot plus PNG encoder.

items.name: dsh-geolibre

items.name: bailinghub-dsh-plugin
items.desc: Let a local DeepSeek Harness Agent use BailingHub to query data, update records, and run permitted actions in an online store, SaaS, or other admin system.

items.name: meb-dsh#workbench
items.desc: Construction cost workbench for DeepSeek Harness projects.

items.name: dsh-api-client
items.desc: Agent-native API client for DeepSeek Harness: Postman-like debugging UI (request tree with context menus and full keyboard navigation, resizable sidebar, layered auto-generated header preview with per-item suppression and constant secret masking), six api_client_* agent tools sharing the same request core, redaction and audit chain with the human UI, Postman Collection v2.1 import with a migration report, environment variables with SecretRef indirection, and a fail-closed SSRF network policy.

items.name: dsh-nuke-plugin
items.desc: Transactional uninstall engine: every destructive action runs validate/preview/execute/undo with Saga rollback, WAL crash recovery, hash-chain audit, hardlink dedup, and a Bayesian oracle that predicts success probability before you commit.

items.name: dsh-wechat-collector
items.desc: WeChat Official Account source collector: QR-login credential profiles, rate-limit-safe crawling with cooldown, RSS second water source, and secret-safe handoff to ContentStudio.

items.name: dsh-rf-toolkit
items.desc: Six RF calculators as agent tools: level conversion, link budget and maximum range, cascade noise figure, Shannon capacity, and impedance match.

items.name: dsh-jev-adapter
items.desc: Use the Jev (System One) decision-model paradigm with any OpenAI-compatible LLM — no TypeSafe key required. Registers a jev_decide tool that returns probability-distributed answers to typed questions (choice/score/boolean) in one call.

items.name: dsh-guardian#dsh-guardian
items.desc: WebUI panel for the dsh-guardian watchdog: start, stop and inspect two macOS LaunchAgents with status, log tail and explicit failure states.

items.name: dsh-bgjobs
items.desc: Runs commands as background jobs that keep executing when DSH exits, with an optional sandbox to constrain file effects, plus a live web panel and offline CLI/GUI management. Windows only for now.

items.name: dsh-database
items.desc: Connect DeepSeek Harness Web to MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle and MongoDB for schema discovery and read-only queries through session-authorized MCP tools.

items.name: dsh-project-mcp
items.desc: Per-project MCP servers: a project declares servers in its own documents (`.dsh/mcp.json` by default; the local and global file lists are settings), and they are mounted only for the sessions working in that project — on the first turn of a session, released when it goes idle. A right-sidebar tab and a Settings page list each project with a live session, the status of every server and the session holding each mount, with `Sync` / `Retry` / `Release`, an `enabled` switch and an editor over one existing entry; a per-project tool policy (`disclosure` / `direct` / `off`) with pins and `mcp_search_tools` decides what the model sees; `${VAR}` references resolve through the project `.env` files and the credentials file; per-server call counters outlive the sessions that produced them.

items.name: dsh-zcode-farm
items.desc: Multi-instance ComfyUI orchestration: probes every configured ComfyUI endpoint for its GPU, free VRAM and queue depth, then dispatches a generation job to the idlest eligible instance. Ships three tools (comfyui_farm_status, comfyui_farm_pick, comfyui_farm_run). An instance is eligible only if it is reachable, has at least the requested free VRAM, and its queue is no deeper than the configured ceiling; eligible instances are ranked by free VRAM minus queue depth times a weight, so an idle shallow queue wins over a busy large one. Zero runtime dependencies. Optional retry on probe failure, because a single timeout across an SSH tunnel is not proof that an instance is down.

items.name: dsh-routed-subagent
items.desc: Adds a subagent_routed tool that runs a one-shot subagent fully mounted on any agent preset from any session, with per-call model/provider override and a model-availability pre-check.

items.name: dsh-engineer-tools
items.desc: Engineering work-tools for DeepSeek Harness: registers two model-facing Host Tools — a scoped `git` runner, and a package-manager runner (`dev`) that detects npm/pnpm/yarn/bun from the workspace lockfile and picks the right verb per manager. Both run through dsh's sandboxed shell and return structured stdout/stderr/exitCode, so the agent gets focused, reviewable results instead of raw bash, and adding another tool is a copy-paste of one register block.

items.name: dsh-icloud-calendar
items.desc: Read and write Apple iCloud Calendar over CalDAV through five tools: list calendars, read a window with recurring events expanded, create an event, and delete behind a dry run that must confirm the exact object count. Credentials come from DPAPI, Keychain or libsecret, or from an environment variable.

items.name: dsh-hot-search
items.desc: Resident search index living in the host process: hot_find (fuzzy filename and path match, with frecency and git status), hot_fuzzy (content search that tolerates typos, including in Chinese), hot_grep (literal and regex content search), hot_plan (groups hits per file so a batch of files can be read in order) and hot_stats. One in-memory line index is built once and rebuilt on demand, so a query does not spawn a process.

items.name: dsh-origin-bridge
items.desc: Drive local Origin/OriginPro from chat via 27 MCP tools: import .dat/.csv/.txt and CHI workstation .bin files, plot, style, fit, and deliver PNG/TIF/SVG/PDF plus an editable .opju project, with read-back verification on plots, styles and exports. Requires Windows, Origin/OriginPro 2021+ and Python 3.10+, plus `pip install originpro numpy` into the interpreter dsh launches: without the package every tool answers `missing_originpro`, and without an interpreter on PATH no tools register at all.

items.name: dsh-router-ext-rtk
items.desc: RTK (Rust Token Killer) extension for dsh-router: rewrites each bash tool call through `rtk rewrite` so the agent reads compressed command output, and falls back to the original command when rtk is missing or has no equivalent.

items.name: lume
items.desc: A persona and memory plugin for DSH Desktop. Distill characters from chats, novels, scripts, or character sheets; keep long-term and temporary memories, learn style corrections and approved replies, detect persona leakage after switching, visualize memories, and import or export persona cards. Task guidance is reduced to one lightweight fixed discipline with no plans, ledgers, or dynamic reminders.

items.name: dsh-econ-tools
items.desc: Econometrics research assistant: 6 tools covering method selection, data preparation, model specification, empirical analysis with Python/R/Stata code templates, robustness checks, and result reporting.

items.name: dsh-unidoc
items.desc: A document preview / edit / management plugin for DeepSeek Harness. It provides a VSCode-style "Document Center" workbench inside the DSH Web GUI: a file tree on the left, click-to-preview, editable code & Markdown with Ctrl/Cmd+S save; and exposes three document tools (doc_read / doc_edit / doc_create) to agents, letting models read and write workspace documents through natural language.

items.name: dsh-scan-mcp
items.desc: Scans MCP servers configured in Claude Code, Codex and CodeBuddy and probes real connectivity via stdio and streamable-http initialize handshakes, with enable/disable toggles and a /mcp control panel.

items.name: dsh-proxy-routing
items.desc: Per-execution HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy routing for Agent fetches, LLM providers, and shell commands, with settings-backed hot reload, approval-gated controls, and credential-safe status.

items.name: dsh-gemini-tool-schema
items.desc: Normalizes every tool schema before it reaches the model, rewriting it into the strict OpenAPI 3.0 subset that Gemini function declarations accept — a type on every node, items on every array, no empty enum entry, $ref inlined — so a single offending MCP or built-in tool no longer fails the whole request with HTTP 400.

items.name: dsh-plugin-porter
items.desc: Moves DSH plugins between machines and profiles: export a migration bundle where local plugins keep their source and remote ones reinstall by version, restore it elsewhere with the bundle's own restore.mjs, copy plugins to another profile, or pack the whole environment (config, memory, sessions, attachments, plugin sources) into checksummed volumes with a restore script.

items.name: dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace
items.desc: Lets one session read, write and run bash across several folders, not just the primary root — additional roots are registered from a sidebar Folders panel or the /workspace-folders command (inherit/read-only/read-write) and share the primary root's file-fence + OS-sandbox authorization; adds no new tools.

items.name: cn-linebreak
items.desc:
Static HTML auditor for Chinese line-breaking: checks explicit-`
` orphan lines, keep-all CSS coverage, CJK line-start/line-end punctuation rules, and protected-phrase splits, then inserts at natural breakpoints; exposes a cn_linebreak_audit tool for agents.

items.name: dsh-system-net
items.desc: Make DSH follow your system network settings: route through the OS proxy and trust its certificate store, so TLS-intercepting accelerators work without environment variables or a restart.

items.name: dsh-context-toolkit
items.desc: Keeps bulk output out of the conversation: ctk_execute, ctk_execute_file and ctk_batch_execute run code in a child process and return only the conclusion, ctk_index and ctk_search file long material into a local FTS5 knowledge base built on node:sqlite, and a routing gate refuses curl and wget before they execute. items.name: dsh-plugin-midscene

Windows only.

items.name: dsh-computer-use

items.name: dsh-electro-lab

items.name: dsh-reckoner
items.desc: A deterministic calculation engine for DeepSeek Harness, including a preset that guides the LLM to calculate through the engine rather than by text generation.

items.name: dsh-stash
items.desc: Registers external databases and document corpora as callable model tools: a per-source access boundary, a credential reference ledger that never stores values, and a fetch ledger that keeps fingerprints and content hashes instead of payloads.

items.name: dsh-balance-inquiry

items.name: dsh-import-newapi

items.name: deepseek-harness-community-plugins#dsh-ai-asset-hub

items.name: dsh-codex-web-search-mcp

items.name: moneypal#dsh-moneypal
items.desc: Personal finance plugin for DSH with structured Beancount ledger tools.

items.name: dsh-delivery-receipt
items.desc: A delivery receipt panel for a project hand-off. One trigger collects the branch and commit, the test and build results, screenshot dimensions with sha256, and the secret-scan verdict, then assigns every line to one of three zones by evidence alone — verified, local-only, or unverified. A claim in the unverified zone keeps its label and prints an explicitly empty slot instead of the claim itself, because a confidently worded sentence with nothing behind it is the exact thing the receipt exists to catch. Test failures and secret-scan hits are still evidence, so they land in the verified zone with a red tone rather than being quietly dropped.

items.name: dsh-ship-receipt
items.desc: A shareable delivery receipt for a project hand-off. The `ship_receipt` tool measures what it can and records what it was told, then sorts every line into three zones: verified (evidence this run produced and that reproduces elsewhere — a command that actually ran with its exit code, a file hash for a file that is under version control, a scan that found files, a git ref present in the recorded remote), local-only (true on this machine alone — uncommitted changes, unpushed commits, an artifact no one else can see), and unverified (no evidence, including every sentence a human typed). A claim with no evidence keeps its label and leaves the body blank rather than printing the claim; declares the commit and branch, artifact byte sizes and sha256 with PNG dimensions, and the three pre-push checks.

items.name: dsh-aoci-bind
items.desc: AOCI binding toolkit for DSH hosts: discover workspaces that have an AOCI index, diagnose and repair their MCP bindings, initialize unbound repos, and expose status and doctor tools.

items.name: dsh-bash-terminal-ts
items.desc: Shell tool with four Windows backends (PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL / MSYS2) plus an interactive PTY terminal; the MSYS2 backend starts bash.exe with -lc so /etc/profile puts /usr/bin and /mingw64/bin on PATH, and injects MSYSTEM=MINGW64 into the PTY environment. Written in TypeScript, targets DSH 0.1.2+.

items.name: dsh-patch-edit-plus
items.desc: Patch-style file editing: one apply_patch tool accepting git/unified diff (default) and Codex apply_patch syntax (opt-in), applying every change all-or-nothing after a full read-only verification pass, with sandbox-aware delete and move and a dry-run mode.

items.name: lightroom-py

items.name: dsh-ds-balance

items.desc: Data cleaning and data enrichment for CSV/XLSX/JSON enterprise lists in DeepSeek Harness, including spreadsheet cleaning, deduplication, profiling, optional Qichacha MCP and exports.

Fork of dsh-computer-use-win.

items.name: fnos-dsh#dsh-failover-search-plugin
items.desc: Multi-source web search and fetch failover for DeepSeek Harness sessions: takes over the session searchProvider and fetchProvider seams and tries configured sources in a chosen order — TinyFish, Tavily and the official search as a fallback that always participates and can be repositioned but not removed. items.name: dsh-folder-timemachine
items.desc: Folder time machine for DeepSeek Harness: snapshot any folder, browse its timeline, roll back with one click — Git-like history without needing Git, for folders that never had a repo (game saves, app config dirs, loose documents). Snapshots are content-addressed and deduplicated, and unchanged files are not re-hashed. Automatic snapshots come in two modes: realtime (fs.watch — one version ~8s after the last change, so a save-all or a build counts once) and timed (checks every N minutes, stores only when something actually changed; identical content never adds an empty version). Empty folders are recorded and recreated on restore. Every restore takes a safety snapshot first, so a rollback is itself undoable, and exact-mode cleanup only removes files and empty folders — a non-empty folder is never deleted. Ships a folder_timemachine model tool (status/history/diff need no approval; writes ask first) plus a floating panel with the timeline, one-click restore and mode switching. Pure JS, zero runtime dependencies, 110 tests included.

items.name: insta360-ai-content-studio
items.desc: Automated daily content pipeline for Insta360 GO 3S: BLE/WiFi remote capture of aquarium footage, wireless import, ffmpeg quality evaluation with decision log, Auto editing (segment selection, TTS narration, music, subtitles), and Bilibili upload via biliup (dry-run by default).

items.name: dsh-whale-dive
items.desc: Read Bilibili and Douyin from a session: WBI-signed Bilibili API calls behind one shared pacer (4 req/s, per-host cooldown after a 412) for video, feed, search, author, comments, danmaku and subtitles, plus Douyin hot list, video, feed and search rendered in a locally launched Edge over CDP.

items.name: dsh-nonead-universal-robots
items.desc: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that lets you control Universal Robots (UR) collaborative arms directly from natural language, developed by Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd. based on the same logic as the company's own nUR MCP Server. (Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd.)

items.name: dsh-region
items.desc: Switches DSH's package download source between the npmmirror China mirror and the official npm registry on timeout or failure, with a Web UI to inspect and switch manually.

items.name: dsh-breadboard
items.desc: DSH hardware sandbox plugin: assemble a 3D scene of ESP32 / BME280 / PIR / LED components with protocol- and voltage-checked port wiring, run real Python project code in the loop against simulated I2C/GPIO hardware with fault injection, let networked device simulators report over HTTP to a real backend (validated end-to-end against a live seat-reservation system), observe a real device read-only and map its state onto the scene, and add support for new boards through data-driven pin definitions. Ships 16 hw_* agent tools plus a bundled SKILL.md.

items.name: gewu-tools
items.desc: Model-agnostic visual-inspection pipeline for text-only agents: page-by-page HTML screenshots plus a ready-made vision-subagent briefing contract (gewu_prep), then source-code truth verification of every finding (gewu_locate); validated on mimo-v2.5 & qwen3.7-plus.

items.name: dsh-agent-picker
items.desc: Agent mode picker for DSH: pick an external Agent CLI (Claude Code, Codex, Qwen Code, Gemini CLI, Aider, Goose, Hermes…) as the session's default executor from a control next to the input box, instead of editing configuration files. The agent roster is data-driven, and installed CLIs are discovered automatically from PATH, the managed CLI directory and a drop-in convention directory. Agents that are installed but still missing credentials or a required background service are shown as "needs setup" rather than silently hidden.

items.name: dsh-everything-find
items.desc: Everything (voidtools) file-name search: everything_find queries the local Everything index to locate files and folders on any indexed drive in milliseconds, and adds a configuration card to the Plugins page.

items.name: dsh-babel
items.desc: Reads Claude Code and Codex plugin configurations to discover and preflight MCP servers and slash commands, with opt-in registration in DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: unity-plugin
items.desc: Drive the Unity Editor from DSH through the official unity CLI: live-Editor scene commands, in-Editor C# eval and runtime command discovery over a warm unity shell session, plus a raw CLI escape hatch for project creation, tests and builds. Mounts Unity's official skill collection alongside its own Unity workflow and Asset Store skills.

items.name: bkn-dsh#openbkn-business-context
items.desc: Business knowledge-network context for DeepSeek Harness: bind a session to an OpenBKN knowledge network, query its objects and metrics through managed MCP tools, and open trace-backed provenance (execution facts and a business graph) for each answer. Ships with the OpenBKN Runtime; the provenance views need an OpenBKN enterprise license.

items.name: dsh-mac-computer-use#plugin
items.desc: Vision-first Mac computer use, for when the accessibility tree is unavailable. Ships 11 desktop_* tools - window list, screenshots, OCR text targeting, numbered elements, coordinate clicks, typing, scrolling, drag - plus a Codex-style cursor overlay with spring animation. Clicks are delivered to the target process, so the real pointer never moves and nothing steals focus. In DSH it shows up as Mac Desktop Control with a settings page that checks the engine and the Screen Recording / Accessibility permissions, with a button that opens the matching System Settings pane. One-time prerequisite: no binary is bundled; clone the repo and run ./install.sh once to compile the dsh-cu engine and the overlay with swiftc (Xcode Command Line Tools - the script stops with a clear message when swiftc is missing or the system is not macOS). Until that is done the desktop_* tools fail with exactly these steps.

items.name: sqlx#sqlx-dsh
items.desc: SQLX database tools: list saved datasources, show or test a connection, execute SQL and open a local result page, with the sqlx CLI installed on first use.

items.name: dsh-plugin-tool-management
items.desc: One settings panel managing MCP, skills, memory, subagents, prompts and sessions; customize scene combos to switch the whole environment; the Agent can also operate this plugin for you.

items.name: dsh-tool-manager
items.desc: Manage tool availability and groups for each Agent Preset, load tools on demand like Skills, and reduce model context usage.

items.name: dsh-tool-imagegen
items.desc: Text-to-image and image-to-image generation via OpenRouter's unified Image API: configurable model aliases with parameters gated against the live model capability listing, reference-image inputs, a settings card, and inline chat display of results.

items.name: open-dream-rsi#deepseek_harness
items.desc: Not another memory plugin: ODR is an evolving-worlds self-improvement loop (Dream-RSI) — attempts are recorded into a Discovery Tree, and between runs thousands of strategy variants are replayed against that recorded world; a strategy, recipe or lesson is promoted only after surviving counterfactual replay, never on the model's word alone, and Sentinel gates tool calls before the budget burns; the LLM stays frozen, installable from npm as dsh-open-dream-rsi.

items.name: deep-blend#bundle
items.desc: Supports DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 with scoped reference Search/Fetch and retains the legacy host path. Create editable Blender models in DSH with linked speaker, cup and lamp dimensions. Resize moved, tilted and animated speaker assemblies while retaining manual details, cameras and timing; author bounded control meshes, subdivision, repeated copies and seeded placement on closed static surfaces. Inspect native object-axis dimensions, local samples and subject-aware multi-view images; immutable revisions and an approval gate preserve edits, with 18 tools for modeling, review and delivery.

items.name: dsh-plugin-zotero
items.desc: Zotero library in a read-only sidebar panel: browse collections, search items, read metadata and full text, and insert a single citation, a selected excerpt, or a whole collection into the conversation draft. A self-hosted bridge connects to the local Zotero integration MCP and registers its tools to the model as mcp__zotero__*, each one individually toggleable.

items.name: dsh-aqua-input-check
items.desc: Aquaculture input register completeness and withdrawal-period date check: deterministic findings with rule IDs.

items.name: dsh-click
items.desc: Windows desktop computer-use tools (click, type, key, screenshot) with freshness checks, approval gating, process-identity verification around every action, and a sanitized audit trail.

items.name: dsh-customs-doc-check
items.desc: Customs declaration document consistency check: field-level findings with rule IDs.

items.name: dsh-data-quality
items.desc: Data quality checking for DeepSeek Harness — profiling, cleaning, and verification pipelines with structured reports.

items.name: dsh-evidence-check
items.desc: Evidence-list completeness check: maps facts to evidence and reports gaps with rule IDs.

items.name: dsh-fmea-table-check
items.desc: Checks an FMEA worksheet for element completeness and for the arithmetic that follows from it - severity, occurrence and detection against the resulting risk priority number - following published FMEA method standards. Reports inconsistencies; it does not judge whether the ratings themselves are appropriate.

items.name: dsh-fund-research
items.desc: Deterministic research reports for Chinese public mutual funds built from public-source data (Tiantian Fund and Eastmoney), pure-function metrics (performance decomposition, holdings penetration, style attribution, manager profile), and versioned reports with a per-number snapshot traceability appendix.

items.name: dsh-gongwen-word-check
items.desc: Checks an official document's type and reference number against the published party and government document format standard - including the bracket form the year is written in and the numbering pattern. Reports what does not match the format; it does not judge the document's content.

items.name: dsh-hazchem-check
items.desc: Checks a hazardous-chemical register for internal consistency: that each substance names its hazard class, that stored quantities parse, that a threshold is recorded, that the major-hazard-source verdict agrees with how the stored quantity compares to the threshold the register states, that safety data sheet numbers are present and CAS numbers are not duplicated. Reports differences for a human to review; it does not decide whether a unit constitutes a major hazard source.

items.name: dsh-icd-rule-check
items.desc: Flags ICD coding pairs that need a coder's attention - dagger and asterisk combinations, combination codes - against GB/T 14396-2016 and published ICD usage notes. Reports the pairs it finds rather than resolving them; the coding decision stays with the coder.

items.name: dsh-laya
items.desc: Laya typed decisions (`noul` yes/no, `choice`, `score`) as a first-class Cordis service (`ctx.laya`) plus the model-visible `laya_ask` and `laya_plan` tools. The plugin itself installs and downloads nothing: it is a client of a `laya-mcp serve` sidecar you start yourself, and it reports that the sidecar is not running instead of failing obscurely at the first tool call.

items.name: dsh-medrec-qc
items.desc: Checks a medical-record front sheet for field completeness and for internal logical contradictions between its fields, against 国卫办医发〔2016〕24号 and other published documents. Lists what is missing or inconsistent for a human to review; it does not assess clinical correctness.

items.name: dsh-nurse-record-check
items.desc: Checks nursing records for entry timing, signatures and assessment-form completeness, against 《病历书写基本规范》 and other published documents. Reports what is missing or out of sequence for a human to review.

items.name: dsh-power-ticket-check
items.desc: Checks an electrical work permit for the elements it must carry and for the issue and permission sequence the current electrical safety regulations require. Reports the differences it finds; it does not judge whether the work was safe or whether the permit was validly authorised.

items.name: dsh-site-log-check
items.desc: Checks supervision logs for cross-day continuity and for on-site supervision coverage, against GB/T 50319-2013 and other published documents. Reports gaps and coverage differences for a human to review.

items.name: dsh-tender-matrix
items.desc: Checks a bid evaluation scoring matrix for internal arithmetic consistency: that each factor's maximum, the scores recorded and the total agree with each other. Reports the differences it finds; it does not judge whether the evaluation itself was correct or fair.

items.name: dsh-ticktick
items.desc: TickTick (Dida365) task bridge: a session-header task panel and curated agent tools over the official TickTick MCP endpoint.

items.name: dsh-translate
items.desc: Tool-output repair layer for DeepSeek Harness — JSON schema enforcement, parameter mapping, and JSON repair for tool calls.

items.name: dsh-bayes-predict
items.desc: Bayesian stock prediction plugin that fuses MACD, RSI, moving-average, volume and other technical signals into an up-move posterior probability with multi-horizon comparison, trend-state classification and position risk metrics for A-share and US stocks.

items.name: anno#dsh-native
items.desc: Local-first HTML review and annotation workspace for coding agents: opens an isolated copy of a file in a browser editor, collects text edits, format changes and element/area comments, and returns a durable handoff the agent can claim and resolve.

items.name: dsh-video-tools
items.desc: Browser-local audio/video toolkit for DSH — extract frames, capture thumbnails, compress images, and convert clips to GIF with FFmpeg.wasm.

items.name: dsh-subagent-antigravity
items.desc: Runs the official Google Antigravity CLI (agy) as a one-shot coding subagent over print-mode stream-json, exposed as the subagent_antigravity delegation tool. Includes Gemini 4 Argon on Antigravity subscriptions. Requires the Antigravity CLI (agy 1.4+) installed and signed in.

items.name: dsh-capability-menu
items.desc: View and manage an agent’s tools and skills in a visual menu. Set each capability to Resident, On-demand, or Disabled; agents can find and use on-demand capabilities while reducing context usage.

items.name: dsh-har-triage
items.desc: Offline HAR diagnostics with endpoint aliases, original entry indexes and minimal HTML/JSON evidence; no recording or request replay.

items.name: dsh-http-probe
items.desc: Adds an http_probe tool for endpoint health checks: status code, latency and key response headers, using HEAD with GET fallback; response bodies are never downloaded.

items.name: dsh-sheet-diff
items.desc: Read-only CSV/XLSX comparison by business keys, with offline HTML review and exportable comments.

items.name: dsh-science-workbench
items.desc: Reproducible science workbench: agent-driven cells, inline figures with feedback/rerun, manifest provenance, environment snapshots, and publication-grade figure skills (9 bio_* tools + workbench UI).

items.name: dsh-claude-delegate
items.desc: Delegates self-contained coding subtasks to the local Claude Code subscription through the official Agent SDK and returns the result to the host session. Nineteen per-call parameters control model, thinking effort, permission mode, allowed tools, turn count and budget cap; background jobs return a jobId immediately and stream incremental output; the result carries a session handle that can be passed back as resume to continue the same conversation; commands expected to run past ~20 seconds go through the built-in mcp__dsh__shell channel, which streams output line by line without consuming model context; a Claude Code monitor panel in the session lists jobs, renders the structured process, shows live output blocks and cancels a run; the delegation procedure ships as a runtime-registered skill, so installing the plugin installs the skill.

items.name: dsh-qianyuan
items.desc: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the QianYuan MCP server, a shared record of pitfalls other agents already hit and results they already produced, plus capability lookup. Exposes 13 tools named mcp__qianyuan__*. Reads are open and need no key.

items.name: dsh-qixin-insight-mcp-oauth
items.desc: Connects the Qixin Insight MCP server over OAuth 2.1 with PKCE as a single plugin entry, mounting its tools as mcp__qixin_insight__* with automatic token refresh and revocation on disconnect.

items.name: dsh-computer-use-windows
items.desc: Windows-only Computer Use plugin for DeepSeek Harness with UIA, cua-driver, and optional GLM vision.

items.name: dsh-graphify-plugin
items.desc: Native Graphify knowledge graph plugin providing 10 code intelligence tools, topological search, god nodes discovery, and PR blast radius triage.

items.name: dsh-tool-folder
items.desc: Folds the tool-definition prompt surface when many MCP servers are installed: a static KV-cache-stable catalog plus BM25/bge-m3 hybrid tools_search and batch tools_schema expansion, so hundreds of tools stay discoverable without spending their full schemas every turn.

items.name: dsh-commander
items.desc: Commander mode for the dsh web GUI: a one-click session header button injects a protocol brief into the session, then parses and auto-executes task blocks in the model reply — separating the strategist loop from worker loops via a visible badge.

items.name: dsh-alist-
items.desc: AList v3 file management: browse, search, upload (streamed and multipart), offline downloads, archive listing, task polling and control, plus admin tools for storages, users, roles, meta rules, settings, search index, shares and labels - 75 tools in total; every write goes through the approval flow and passwords are never read back.

items.name: miran-fann-dsh
items.desc: Motion graphics from a dsh session through the Miran Fann engine over MCP, with a Miran settings page and motion-design skills. Requires the Miran Fann engine installed separately (npx miran-fann setup) and a signed-in install.

items.name: dsh-jev-plugin
items.desc: A `jev` tool that asks Jev (TypeSafe System One) typed yes/no, choice and score questions about one block of text and returns probabilities and confidence, with the provider and API key configured per user in Settings, a judgment ledger with its spend, and daily call and token caps.

items.name: dsh-tracescope#dsh-tracescope
items.desc: DSH right-sidebar plugin that compares two git commits, builds a manual-test checklist from the impact scope, and supports fail notes, screenshots, task attachments, and defect submission to Yunxiao, GitHub, GitLab, or a webhook.

items.name: dsh-web-search-9router
items.desc: 9router-backed web search and fetch for DeepSeek Harness. Enabling the bundle automatically routes native web_search/web_fetch tools to 9router; disabling it restores the remaining provider configuration.

items.name: dsh-tool-router
items.desc: Hides tool schemas from the model's prefill and reveals one tool at a time through a decision model API. Requires a running decision-model API endpoint and pnpm on PATH.

items.name: dsh-gitbash-new
items.desc: Windows bash tool for DeepSeek Harness: replaces the preset pwsh with Git for Windows or MSYS2 (UCRT64/MINGW64/CLANG64/...) bash while keeping the official terminal contract — workdir, background jobs and timeout promotion, result markers, terminal cards — and adds a settings row that discovers and validates Git/MSYS2 installations.

items.name: graphflow
items.desc: Local-first code knowledge graph for coding agents: 10 MCP tools for layered context compression, DAG planning, incremental AST indexing, a cross-session skill flywheel, diagnostics, and graph artifact import/export.

items.name: dsh-session-tree-extension
items.desc: Pi-style append-only multi-branch session trees: fork or jump to any historical node without deleting history, clone a branch into a new session, and browse the tree in a WebUI panel. Works on stock Harness via graceful degradation.

items.name: reaudit-ai-plugin#dsh-reaudit
items.desc: Mounts the hosted Reaudit MCP server (https://mcp.reaudit.io/mcp) through the in-box @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client bridge with a REAUDIT_API_KEY bearer token: 238 mcp__reaudit__* tools for brand visibility in AI answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews), competitor and citation analysis, site audits, content generation and social scheduling.

items.name: dsh-whale-catch
items.desc: Right-sidebar basket that collects the files a session produced or changed without the agent having to register them, with preview, zip packaging, and one-click archiving.

items.name: rotifer-playground#rotifer
items.desc: Rotifer Protocol skills plus the Rotifer MCP server, configured as instances of DSH's own skill provider and MCP client: search Genes, compare them on Arena rankings, install or roll back Genes in the local project, and create and run local Agents. The MCP server is version-pinned and limited to its evolve tool set, which leaves out publishing and login.

items.name: dsh-tool-weather
items.desc: Model-facing weather tool that queries current conditions and 7-day forecasts from public Open-Meteo APIs, with no API key required.

items.name: dsh-cad
items.desc: Read-only CAD tools that inspect, extract and export DWG/DXF drawings, including SVG and PNG previews and DXF conversion.

items.name: dsh-undo
items.desc: Turn-level file undo for tool writes and edits: each file is snapshotted before the write lands, and the model (an undo tool), the human (a /undo command) or a button in the assistant message action row can roll back every file a turn changed. Snapshots are written in-process rather than by shelling out, so it needs no extra sandbox permission in sessions confined to workspace-write.

items.name: dsh-dotclaude
items.desc: Runs a Claude Code project's .claude/ slash commands and permissions.deny rules inside DeepSeek Harness. Command bodies expand $ARGUMENTS, positional arguments and @file references into the agent's next turn; matching tool calls are denied before they run. Every host service is probed, so a host without a command registry, working-directory service or TUI status line degrades one feature instead of failing the boot.

items.name: dsh-universe-api
items.desc: Offline, deterministic public API catalog search for DeepSeek Harness, with Chinese and English queries plus exact filters for authentication, HTTPS, CORS, status, source tier, and category.

items.name: dsh-unitverse
items.desc: Unit conversion as a `convert` tool: 10 categories (length, area, volume, time, angle, speed, temperature, pressure, energy/heat, power) and 82 units with English and Chinese aliases, plus a locale-aware Unit Converter tab in the DSH web view with one module per category and a temperature-difference (Δ) switch.

items.name: dsh-windows-c-cleanup
items.desc: Windows system-drive (C:) cleanup for DSH: rule-based scan, five-tier safety grading, a staging area with a rollback ledger, UAC elevation, and migration to another drive — a model tool plus a Web GUI panel.

items.name: dsh-toutiao-reader
items.desc: A webfetch tool for full-text web/Toutiao articles: 3-tier strategy (direct fetch → resident Edge CDP headless browser → dump-dom fallback), with automatic Toutiao anti-bot challenge handling plus a bundled experience skill.

items.name: dsh-bili-watch
items.desc: Reads Bilibili video content as text for DSH agents: metadata, subtitles, ASR, frame OCR, comments and danmaku. Frame OCR needs ffmpeg; the ASR/OCR venvs need Python 3.10+; AI subtitles need a Bilibili login.

items.name: dsh-plugin-mermaid-gb-svg
items.desc: Converts Mermaid flowcharts into GB/T 1526-1989 (ISO 5807) compliant SVG through one model-facing tool, with optional A4/A3 pagination.

items.name: jieyatool
items.desc: Batch recursive extraction: magic-byte format detection (disguised extensions), nested archive auto-unroll, multi-password pool with per-layer dynamic discovery, SFX/split-volume pairing.

items.name: dsh-mac-cua
items.desc: Computer Use for macOS desktop applications: reads any app's accessibility tree as text with element indices, then clicks, types, pastes, scrolls, drags, selects text and sets values through it, plus screenshots read back as images. Driven by a persistent JavaScript REPL — the agent gets two tools (`js`, `js_reset`) and calls an `sky` API inside them, so state survives between calls and the tool schema stays fixed as capabilities grow. Accessibility trees come back as diffs after the first read; actions address elements by index and indices from a stale read are refused rather than misapplied; typing waits for keyboard focus and reads the field back; paste restores the clipboard. Requires macOS 14.4+, Accessibility permission (Screen Recording only for screenshots) and Node 20+; ships a prebuilt native module, so nothing compiles at install time.

items.name: dsh-zhouli
items.desc: Ships the Zhouli-mode agent preset, which runs a session in three phases (declaring roles on opening, citing authorities while working, a six-item self-audit at the close), plus one tool with seven actions over a bundled 49,384-character 《周礼》 corpus that returns every passage with a stable 篇序.职官序 coordinate, a per-office establishment index and collation between two Kanripo witnesses.

items.name: dsh-wall-mcp-manager
items.desc: A plugin for managing MCP servers in DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: dsh-plugin-deepsearch
items.desc: Switch DSH's built-in web_search between the DeepSeek Search API (/v1/tools/search) and the default account search, with automatic fallback, a settings page and a sidebar switch.

items.name: cue-skills#cue-data-mcp
items.desc: Exposes Cue public data MCP services to DeepSeek Harness: 15 streamable-http domains (~104 tools) for regulatory, macro, disclosures, statute, holdings, entity, academic, IPO, ESOP, buyback, footnote and fact-index data as native mcp__cue_<domain>__* tools.

items.name: cue-skills#cue-omni-reader
items.desc: Cue Omni Reader for DeepSeek Harness: registers the audited omni-reader-mcp MCP server so its URL/file parse tools surface as mcp__omni__ (parse, get_parse_status, read_result, read_outline, save_result, discard_result, cancel_parse).

items.name: hermes-dsh-bridge#dsh-hermes-link
items.desc: Bidirectional bridge between Hermes Agent and DeepSeek Harness: dispatch_task with UI-visible sessions in the DSH sidebar, session mirroring, and 10 DSH-to-Hermes tools.

items.name: kaipu-dsh-plugin-release#plugin-wisdom
items.desc: Companion sidebar panel for the Kaipu site plugin: shows the built-in advisory team and seat status. Install together with kaipu-platform — seat data comes from the site plugin's gateway endpoints; a standalone install honestly reports "channel not ready". Removable: uninstall it and the site plugin stays fully usable.

items.name: dsh-rea-mcp
items.desc: Config-only DeepSeek Harness bundle that mounts the in-box MCP client bridge against morluto/rea over stdio, for reverse engineering anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.

items.name: dsh-windows-mcp-lite
items.desc: Config-only DeepSeek Harness bundle that mounts the in-box MCP client bridge against CursorTouch/Windows-MCP, excluding PowerShell, FileSystem, Registry, Process and Scrape by default (16 of the 21 tools upstream 0.8.8 publishes). Requires uv on PATH.

items.name: dsh-prompt-only-forge
items.desc: Prompt-polish template injector for DSH: click ✨ in the composer to inject a "polish my prompt" template (current draft auto-embedded), no send, no network, no model — the main agent rewrites with full context. Replaces narrative-prompt-polish (2026-09-14 migration).

items.name: dsh-mcp-manager
items.desc: MCP server manager for DSH: nine mcp_manager_* tools, a CLI and a web panel that list, validate, probe, add, edit, enable/disable and remove servers in ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml, search and install servers from the official MCP Registry, and locate or rotate stored credentials.

items.name: dm-inspect
items.desc: Run a read-only Dameng DM8 database inspection with 85 checks and produce an HTML report.

items.name: dm-recovery
items.desc: Read-only assessment of whether a Dameng DM8 database can be recovered and to which point (LSN or time), across 16 recovery scenarios, with an HTML report. Needs Java 8+ and a Dameng JDBC driver jar (DmJdbcDriver8.jar) that you provide yourself.

items.name: dsh-debate
items.desc: Answers hard questions by staging a formal debate: two adversarial subagents argue opposite sides with research, then the main agent rules on the transcript through the debate_open, debate_round, and debate_verdict tools.

items.name: dsh-plan-mode-plus
items.desc: ZCode-style enhancement of dsh plan mode: a model-initiated enter_plan_mode tool, hard interception of write-class tools at dispatch time (ctx.tools.guard) while planning, and a four-phase planning prompt section (explore, design, review, exit), reusing the official plan/mode state machine and exit review flow.

items.name: dsh-skill-compat-plus
items.desc: Mounts external skill directories (Claude Code, Codex, ZCode) into DSH as read-only skill providers: frontmatter field mapping, name slug normalization and hot reload.

items.name: dsh-tool-todo-plus
items.desc: Drop-in enhanced fork of the official todo_write tool: priority tags on each task, full checklist rendering in the conversation, and a draggable in-session floating task panel with position memory, double-click reset and a live indicator of the action currently being executed.

items.name: dsh-eco-indicator
items.desc: Economic indicator lookup via World Bank open data (GDP, inflation, trade, population), no API key required.

items.name: dsh-journal-monitor
items.desc: Economics-first journal/working-paper monitor for DeepSeek Harness: NBER RSS + arXiv econ (4 categories) + Chinese econ journals (Shi Jie Jing Ji via Magtech, Zhong Guo Nong Cun Guan Cha, Cai Mao Jing Ji, Zhong Guo Ren Kou Ke Xue, Jing Ji Guan Li via ajcass) fetch, keyword filter, dry-run/Webhook push, dedup persistence, and schedule_create-compatible briefing.

items.name: dsh-toolkit#dsh-at-file
items.desc: A @-file reference tool for DSH: registers an at_file_read tool that injects workspace-file contents into the session, with traversal protection and a 50KB truncation cap (MIT).

items.name: dsh-math-plugin#dsh-math
items.desc: SymPy-backed exact computation and independent verification for China's postgraduate entrance exam Mathematics I: 14 tools over 214 operators, exact symbolic results by default, and every result re-checked by a separate mechanism (requires Python 3.10+ with sympy and mpmath).

items.name: dsh-blender-plugin
items.desc: Lets a DSH agent drive a local Blender over a direct TCP channel with 16 tools: viewport frames, custom-angle renders, Python execution, headless and job offload, transaction rollback, and a planning layer of 186 ops across 28 families.

items.name: dsh-retry-guard
items.desc: Observes consecutive identical tool failures and optionally pauses before the next model step, preserving original results and successful repeats, with an in-chat report in DSH Web.

items.name: portfolio-os#dsh-portfolio-os
items.desc: Self-contained personal portfolio and investment-research workspace for DSH with local registration, asset import and allocation views, market and news tracking, a research library, and optional user-configured AI briefs; ships a Windows runtime and stores data locally.

items.name: dsh-vault
items.desc: Encrypted, chunked full backups of a DSH installation: config, sessions, plugins, workspaces and Hindsight memory packed into AES-256-GCM volumes that unlock by passphrase, recovery code or this machine's DPAPI slot, each package carrying a self-contained restorer, GFS rotation (last, daily, weekly, monthly, plus a total size cap and a recycle bin) and network or WebDAV targets. Zero external dependencies — node: builtins only, no 7z, openssl or rclone.

items.name: dsh-prompt-refine
items.desc: A ✨ button left of the send button: reads the draft and recent turns, asks the configured model for three suggestions each pairing an issue with a patch, lets you tick them individually with a live preview of the merged prompt, and writes the result back to the composer without sending.

items.name: dsh-launcher
items.desc: macOS menu bar app for the DSH web server, plus the host plugin it reads: the plugin writes the running server's port, PID and tokenized URL to ~/.config/dsh-launcher/runtime.json and removes it on shutdown, so start, open, restart and stop work from the status bar even for a server started from a terminal.

items.name: dsh-tool-pwsh-safe
items.desc: Runs PowerShell scripts through base64 encoding, so quotes, $, backslashes and CJK survive as written. Same sandbox channel as the built-in pwsh tool.

items.name: deepseek-computer-use
items.desc: Windows desktop control through UI Automation, window screenshots and mouse/keyboard input, with per-session app consent and action approvals.

items.name: dsh-ros2
items.desc: ROS2 debugging toolset and robot-state vision analysis for DeepSeek Harness: node/topic/service/action/interface/TF enumeration, whole-graph topology JSON, rosdep checks, approval-gated builds and custom message scaffolding, GUI screenshots and multimodal vision observation, plus headless RViz2 offscreen rendering (low-poly meshes, direct pixel read, GPU passthrough - motion rendering at 30Hz) with parallel VLM realtime analysis.

items.name: dsh-leekbox
items.desc: A-share market dashboard: realtime quotes and indices, millisecond full-market search, market sentiment thermometer, candlestick K-line detail popups, watchlist, ETF/convertible-bond/LOF boards, screener, and a 7x24 aggregated news feed.

items.name: dsh-link-collect
items.desc: Stores bookmarks as local Markdown files in a folder you choose, with a sidebar page for collections and links, library-wide search, automatic favicon downloads, and three agent tools.

items.name: dsh-fhl-image-plugin
items.desc: FHL Images generation and multi-reference editing for DeepSeek Harness, with three agent tools, a pool of up to ten API-key workers, and chat-based key configuration.

items.name: macos-computer-use-kit#dsh
items.desc: AX-first macOS computer use for DeepSeek Harness: accessibility snapshots with stable refs, background input, Unicode typing, menus and apps, set-of-mark screenshots, on-device OCR and verified actions — 11 tools bridged to the macos-cu CLI.

items.name: dsh-rich-questions
items.desc: Branching surveys in the web GUI: the ask_survey tool with per-option routing, hover insights, Mermaid diagrams, quick one-click answer templates, and resumable banked progress.

items.name: dsh-rich-tracking
items.desc: Percent-progress scoreboard docked below the todo pill: tracking_write rows with evidence-bound percents, host-captured git checkpoints with before/after deltas, and pursue/align/dismiss actions that reach the agent as instructions.

items.name: dsh-ops
items.desc: Provides bash, PowerShell 7, and high-performance Rust tools for DSH on Windows to reduce token usage.

items.name: dsh-llm-as-a-verifier
items.desc: Fine-grained LLM verification for DSH agents: pairwise rewards over score-token logprobs, Probabilistic Pivot Tournament best-of-N selection, and per-step progress tracking.

items.name: dsh-snippets
items.desc: Minimal snippet and command toolbox for DSH: five tools over a single human-editable JSONL file, zero UI, zero database, zero network, explicit save-only memory.

items.name: weknora#dsh-weknora
items.desc: Four read-only tools over a WeKnora knowledge base: list knowledge bases, hybrid passage search, reassemble one document's chunks in order, and WeKnora's own cited RAG or ReAct-agent answer with a resumable session id.

items.name: cloudbase-ai-toolkit#dsh-plugin
items.desc: Tencent CloudBase backend for DeepSeek Harness — scaffold and deploy full-stack apps from chat, render query results as table cards with paging, sorting and CSV export, preview a deployment on its domain, and call the CloudBase MCP toolset (`mcp__cloudbase__*`) with device-code login.

items.name: marketingdashboard
items.desc: Zero-key market data MCP server (dsh bundle): 5 MCP tools for A-share/HK/US quotes, sector rankings, futures, money flow and 7x24 news, with a three-tier upstream fallback.

items.name: dsh-realtimeavatar
items.desc: Realtime Avatar (realtimeavatar.ai) for agents: the developer API key held by the harness credentials store, the public docs as five on-demand skills, rta_* tools over the public REST API (balance, avatars, clips, sessions, usage) with approval-gated credit spending, and a /rta command that walks a developer from no key to a live avatar call.

items.name: dsh-unity-mcp
items.desc: One-shot mcp-unity integration for DeepSeek Harness: bundled MCP server with zero manual config lets the agent drive the Unity editor through 34 tools - scenes, game objects, transforms, materials, prefabs, menu items, play mode, tests and console logs - with auto-reconnect.

items.name: dsh-formatforge#dsh-formatforge
items.desc: FormatForge: forge 30+ file formats (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, EML, EPUB, TOML, archives) into AI-readable text via a drag-and-drop inbox, ff_translate/ff_formats/ff_result tools and a CLI; scanned PDFs fall back to local OCR or an enhance hint for the session model.

items.name: dsh-astock-research
items.desc: China A-share stock research: ticker search, announcements over any date range, financial report cards, valuation profiles and signal-factor explanations (~5,000 stocks since 2011, public read-only data service), plus a link-out tool to an external trading-sandbox product.

items.name: dsh-find-ideas
items.desc: GitHub project search and analysis: describe your idea in one sentence and the agent searches GitHub for related projects, ranks them by relevance weighted with stars, and returns a structured card — last updated, relevance, stars, weighted score, language and a one-line description for each project. Pick a few repositories and it reads their README, dependency manifest, directory tree and key files to lay out their architecture — so you stand on the shoulders of giants before you start building.

items.name: dsh-cheatengine
items.desc: DSH plugin bridging agents to Cheat Engine for dynamic memory debugging: scanning, pointer analysis, breakpoints, and game memory hacking.

items.name: dsh-scratch-vault
items.desc: Diverts operation-script writes out of the workspace into a per-session scratch root and collects each one into an inspectable vault outside the workspace, so the workspace holds only real deliverables.

items.name: clawtouch-mcp#dsh-clawtouch
items.desc: Computer use through an external USB HID device: name a target in plain language, a vision model locates it in a cropped window screenshot, and a Raspberry Pi Pico 2 moves the real mouse and types on the real keyboard. 7 tools. Windows has window listing, per-window cropping and automatic window raising; macOS needs pyobjc and has neither; Linux is unsupported.

items.name: geochat#deepseek-harness
items.desc: Session-scoped GeoGebra canvas with 20 native tools for drawing, scene readback, text layout checks and animation capture, plus 55 mathematical skills and bundled offline applet assets.

items.name: dsh-code-reading-coach
items.desc: Interactive code-reading coach for DeepSeek Harness: a five-phase guided walkthrough of the source behind a paper, starting by identifying its language and framework.

items.name: dsh-feyagate
items.desc: DSH plugin that installs, supervises and auto-upgrades the local miloco-mcp-server background service, bridges its MCP tools into DSH and adds service, account and license settings panels.

items.name: dsh-data-agent
items.desc: Database connections and SQL for DeepSeek Harness: register data sources, browse and comment schemas, run AST-checked SQL with a per-source read-only toggle, and render bar, line and pie charts, from chat or the Settings page.

items.name: dsh-harvest
items.desc: Multi-platform research and deep search pipeline: harvest_scout for parallel discovery across GitHub, Web, Twitter, Reddit, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, and YouTube, harvest_deep_research for automated comprehensive research reports, plus extract, cross-source verification, and credibility auditing.

items.name: dshplugin
items.desc: Generates 3Blue1Brown-style Manim animations to explain answers, with a right-column gallery and inline multi-modal file publishing.

items.name: dsh-proxy
items.desc: Hot-switches in-process DSH fetch traffic among direct, manual HTTP(S)/SOCKS5 proxy, and ambient system-proxy modes, with no-proxy rules and optional proxy-environment export for newly spawned child processes.

items.name: dsh-blender-mc
items.desc: Turns a Minecraft Java save into a Blender cover or animation: scans the .mca region files for flat open ground, exports the terrain to OBJ, and drives Blender headless with MCprep materials, the BPS character rig and three-point lighting. After each render it reviews the frame with OpenCV for facing, ground contact, exposure, lighting and composition, then re-renders with adjusted parameters when a check fails. Requires Blender 4.2 LTS or newer and Python 3.10+ with opencv-python and numpy; the first run assembles the Minecraft assets with the bundled setup command.

items.name: dsh-universal-worldbook
items.desc: Request-level one-time prompt injection without further context pollution. SillyTavern-style UI and data compatibility, keyword/regex/constant triggers, and a lore_lookup tool for on-demand searching.

items.name: dsh-plugin-codegraph-project
items.desc: A CodeGraph tool scoped to the session's own indexed project, resolved from its workspace directory. One MCP server is launched through npx per project root and shared by every session working there; a project indexed mid-session is enabled without a restart, and the managed child process is reaped when the harness exits.

items.name: maa-dsh-skill
items.desc: A DeepSeek Harness Skill built on the official command-line tool maa-cli for MaaAssistantArknights (MAA), enabling direct control of MaaCore to automate daily tasks in Arknights.

items.name: newagentuniversebydeepseek#dsh
items.desc: NewAgentUniverseByDeepSeek nodes inside DSH: five read-only tools covering provenance (both upstream releases this build names), a data directory's restored state and ledger audit, the conformance vectors, exact decimal conversion, and node reachability. Driving the node -- starting or stopping a daemon, depositing funds, sending bus messages -- is deliberately not exposed, because those are audited privileged operations in this project.

items.name: dsh-units
items.desc: Unit conversion toolbox covering 20 categories — length, mass, temperature, area, volume (incl. US cooking units), speed, time, data sizes (decimal MB vs binary MiB), data transfer rates (Mbps vs MB/s), acceleration incl. g-force, illumination (lux / foot-candle), pressure, energy, angle, frequency, power incl. three horsepower definitions, force, torque, typography (px/pt/em/rem), and fuel economy (mpg ↔ L/100km). Two tools — convert_unit and list_units — zero runtime dependencies, pure arithmetic; each result includes the formula applied.

items.name: dsh-webfetch
items.desc: Web reading tools for text-only agents. Five read-only tools: web_fetch (any URL rendered as clean Markdown or plain text), web_links (inventory of a page's links), web_feed (RSS 2.0 / Atom entries), web_headers (HTTP status, response headers and redirect chain without downloading the body, HEAD with automatic GET fallback), and web_table (HTML tables extracted as structured rows with header detection and colspan/rowspan grid expansion). Transport is Node fetch plus a zero-dependency HTTP proxy implementation (CONNECT tunnelling, absolute-URI requests, NO_PROXY with suffix/wildcard/IPv4-CIDR matching, Proxy-Authorization). Zero runtime dependencies.

items.name: ccreach-dsh-web-search
items.desc: CCReach capability-search provider for DeepSeek Harness, letting agents discover data sources, tools, APIs, MCP servers, skills and workflows.

items.name: dsh-live-data
items.desc: Ten live-data tools over eight keyless public APIs: FX rates, weather, npm/PyPI versions, GitHub repo stats, Bilibili video stats, A-share/index/gold quotes, and IP geolocation. Tool defaults are configurable in settings.

items.name: dsh-pace-calc
items.desc: Running pace calculator: converts distance and time to min/km pace and km/h speed.

items.name: toolshrink
items.desc: Content-aware tool-result reducer: 13 reducers cut oversized output by meaning at tools/post-execute (failing tests kept, diff context dropped, JSON and CSV sampled, lint problems grouped by rule, dependency stack frames collapsed, crowded directories counted), with full originals spilled to disk behind a locator.

items.name: dsh-game-material-master
items.desc: Generates game art from reference images via Seedream image generation and MiniMax image-to-video, assembling eight-direction sprites, sequence frames, and skeleton animations with local green-screen keying.

items.name: dsh-file-bookmark
items.desc: Manage frequently used file bookmarks in DeepSeek Harness, supporting bookmark saving, listing and navigation. It also allows creation of frequently used projects, including management projects, code projects and more.

items.name: dsh-ssq-plugin
items.desc: SSQ (China Welfare Lottery Double Color Ball) helper for DeepSeek Harness: 1000-draw trend tracking, six prediction models with ensemble voting, structure analysis and dan-tuo/random generation via the ssq tool.

items.name: dsh-coderag
items.desc: Code retrieval engine exposed as an MCP server: four tools (code_search, code_outline, code_index, index_status) over a SQLite FTS5 index with BM25 ranking, CJK bigram indexing, declaration-aware tree-sitter chunking, incremental reindexing, and a three-layer secret filter. The bigram index matches Chinese-language queries against English code, and the default path needs no vector store or embedding model. Requires a local Python 3.10-3.12 engine installed by scripts/install.sh, and CODERAG_ROOT set in the profile patch.

items.name: dsh-bash-windows
items.desc: Windows settings switch that replaces PowerShell with Git Bash across the four built-in presets, including a persistent terminal in minimal mode.

items.name: dsh-computer-use-windows
items.desc: Windows desktop control with window-bound screenshots and accessibility state, text readback, DSH approvals, and activity overlays.

items.name: dsh-plugin-cats
items.desc: Fetches random cat facts and images from public APIs for AI agents.

items.name: dsh-rea-mcp-toggle
items.desc: Toggles the rea-mcp server on and off from the DSH Web UI session header or through the rea_mcp_toggle agent tool, so the 170 mcp__rea__* tool schemas stop being sent with every request while REA is off (the tools payload drops from about 722 KB to about 95 KB) and the REA child process exits; the choice is kept in a profile-scoped state file and restored at startup by a row-level disabled expression.

items.name: dsh-cuda
items.desc: Run Python on the local NVIDIA CUDA GPU from DeepSeek Harness: device status, foreground and detached jobs, durable logs, and a measured peak-VRAM figure per run.

items.name: dsh-phone-butler
items.desc: Inspect and tidy a real Android phone over adb: storage surveys, per-app data sizes read from dumpsys diskstats without root, cache clearing that preserves app data, directory measurements and screenshots — five tools; reads never modify anything, writes require explicit confirmation.

items.name: ark-cli#ark-managed-agents
items.desc: Adds a Managed Agents settings tab and MCP tools to dispatch long-running agent tasks to Ark cloud Managed Agents.

items.name: dsh-xia-plugins#packages/global-proxy
items.desc: Route every host-process undici fetch through a local HTTP(S) proxy while keeping localhost and China-reachable APIs direct.

items.name: dsh-better
items.desc: Archived-session management, task-stop notifications, an update checker, model routing (keyword rules + allowlist-gated model_route), multi-task scheduled triggers (heartbeats and fixed-time tasks), and a DeepSeek-style message scroll nav for the dsh web GUI.

items.name: dsh-draft-polish
items.desc: One-click draft polish for the DSH composer: rewrites your spoken draft into professional wording, sends only the draft snapshot (never conversation context), and never blocks sending if the LLM is unavailable.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-mcp-davinci-resolve
items.desc: Registers the MCP server built into DaVinci Resolve 21.1+ as an MCP server in DSH, so an agent can drive Resolve through its scripting API.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-mcp-flapi
items.desc: Registers FilmLight's official FLAPI MCP assistant (flapi-dev-mcp) as an MCP server in DSH, so an agent can write and run Baselight / Daylight FLAPI scripts.

items.name: dsh-geoserver
items.desc: Read GeoServer WMS services and render map images in the dsh web GUI, with a settings card for server, username, and password.

items.name: dsh-motor-ai-l0
items.desc: Motor-design AI assistant plugin: requirement parsing → parameter identification → candidate matrix → Top10 verification. L0 is a millisecond-level broad filter (pure JS, zero solver dependency) that ranks candidates and emits the handoff payload for the L1/L2 precision tools; usable as a local agent preset and Cordis plugin. L1 (RMxprt) and L2 (Motor-CAD) are reserved in this version — the level gate fails fast above l0.

items.name: dsh-disk-manager
items.desc: Scans the whole C drive and classifies every large folder into A/B/C/D/E/P (safe cache / relocatable / junction-movable / abandoned software / config-memory redline / personal files), then deletes, moves, or redirects on demand — with strong redline protection, dry-run preview and undo. Unknown software decided by LLM fallback + human confirmation. Works on DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7 through 0.2.x, tested on 0.2.0-rc.1.

items.name: dsh-lost-and-found
items.desc: Local file recall: indexes the folders you choose into one local SQLite database, so 'where did I put that file?' is one query instead of a disk walk. Caches, VCS and program folders are pruned per directory; each folder keeps its own incremental anchor, so a folder added later is backfilled in full. Read-only: it never modifies, moves or deletes your files. Works on DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7 through 0.2.x, tested on 0.2.0-rc.1.

items.name: dsh-resume-screening
items.desc: Resume screening plugin for HR in DeepSeek Harness: ingest up to 100k Word/PDF/Excel resumes into one searchable library with skills / coarse categories / ingest time, auto-ingest & de-dupe new resumes, then screen by plain-language criteria — rule pre-filter in the database plus LLM fine-judge on the shortlisted few, CSV export. Works on DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7 through 0.2.x, tested on 0.2.0-rc.1.

items.name: dsh-screenshot-capture
items.desc: Point-and-shoot screenshot capture: a system floating window turns a new screenshot (or copied image) into an Obsidian note with comments and key-point marking, instant OCR through the host DSH multimodal model (no extra API key needed, Tongyi Qianwen as fallback), a duplicate-screen guard, per-day merging, and an optional evening AI organization pass.

items.name: dsh-word-vault
items.desc: English word bank for one or more children, built for DSH 0.2 and newer (0.2.0-rc.1 and 0.2.0-rc.2 verified, including the desktop shell; 0.1.7 through 0.2.x all work). 1.10 added pronunciation: in the memory cards and in the online quiz every word and every example sentence has a speaker button that reads it aloud with the built-in Windows voice - offline, with no network call and no model call - and the whole batch of audio is pre-rendered in the background whenever cards or an exam are generated, so a click starts instantly. 1.11 adds: pick words in bulk straight from the library (10 at a time, top-down, up to 50 selected, with a live counter); turn the words a child got wrong in a quiz into a one-click review set - an online card page that speaks plus a printable PDF; and every card example sentence now carries its Chinese translation underneath. Words marked on textbook or workbook photos (highlighter, red pen) are found by their marks, then translated and stored in a local SQLite bank with an occurrence count; the clipboard picker, the photo route and dictation all land in the same bank. High-frequency words surface by count, three correct answers in a row flag a word as learned, and any selection prints as a memory card set (a word split into chunks, real IPA per chunk, a grade-7 example sentence, a mnemonic hook, an A4 sheet of eight) in HTML, PDF or Word, with a print-and-answer exam page whose four options are set against each other for meaning. On 0.1.5 the settings panel does not appear - install dsh-word-vault@1.0.2 instead.

items.name: deepseeklauncher
items.desc: macOS desktop launcher with an installation skill: starts or reuses the local DeepSeek Harness web service and opens it in Google Chrome, with a transparent character and thought bubble icon.

items.name: dsh-quick-translate
items.desc: Quick translation using DSH models: streaming output, token usage details, and local history.

items.name: dsh-novel
items.desc: Novel-writing console for DSH: five novel_* tools for the agent (list, read, context, save chapter, cast) plus a side panel with a book wizard, a cast/relation view and streaming chapter continuation.

items.name: dsh-comfyui-canvas
items.desc: From chat to canvas to artwork — drive ComfyUI as a visual workflow IDE inside DSH. Embed ComfyUI (local or cloud) as a split-screen canvas in DeepSeek Harness Web: the agent sparks ideas, writes prompts and scripts right in the chat, applies them live to the canvas in front of you, and produces images, music, video, and 3D. From idea to finished output without ever leaving the conversation or switching front-ends: Canvas ops — compose and arrange pipelines, read/write workflows, edit nodes, wire links, run, tune parameters, and debug errors, all live and WYSIWYG on the exact canvas you are looking at; Production tasks — batch parameter sweeps (batch_run) and automatic output-image retrieval back into the chat (get_outputs), powering multi-modal creative and batch generation across images, music, video, and 3D; Environment upkeep — one-click launch of ComfyUI and one-click upgrade of the core plus every custom node (upgrade), keeping the stack healthy without interruption. This package is the DSH-side plugin, and it ships the ComfyUI-side bridge node too.

items.name: dsh-env-inspector
items.desc: PC environment diagnostics & port control board: zero-dependency inspection of system, CLI toolchains, active listening ports with hover-to-kill release, and model key readiness. No external calls, zero plaintext secrets.

items.name: disk-sentinel
items.desc: Analyze Windows disk usage, compare scans, and manage cache cleanup and developer environment migration in DSH Web.

items.name: dsh-file-share
items.desc: Session workspace file manager: adds a "Files" tab to the conversation area to browse the current session workspace directory tree and manage it in place (upload, download, mkdir, rename, delete, search), with files mentionable into the composer for the agent to process.

items.name: dsh-webdav-server
items.desc: WebDAV server: turns a shared directory into a WebDAV service that Windows, macOS and Linux can mount as a local disk, with token authentication, optional read-only mode, configurable directory/port/token, and per-platform mounting guides built into the settings page.

items.name: dsh-print3d
items.desc: 3D printing & additive manufacturing plugin for DeepSeek Harness: parametric STL generation, calibration G-code, STL/G-code analysis, toolpath rendering and PrusaSlicer bridge, plus 5 skills and a concise persona optimized for local models.

items.name: dsh-rss
items.desc: RSS/Atom reader with grouped subscriptions and unread/total counts, FreshRSS account sync over the Google Reader API with read/star written back, local image proxy, optional BYOK AI summary/translate/Q&A, podcast audio playback and full-text fetch.

items.name: dsh-clipfile
items.desc: Attach files and folders in the composer via clipboard paste, a native file/folder picker, and @-mention path search; folders are converted to paged Markdown for the agent to read page by page. macOS only (clipboard and picker go through osascript).

items.name: dsh-deepseek-web
items.desc: Read-only DeepSeek web archive tools for DSH: list/download/search sessions, share-list, and a digest tool that compresses the 100-session history into one high-density page with activity bars and topic clusters. Write operations are intentionally not exposed (the web client rate-limits them). Requires the separately installed deepseek-ops Python client (github.com/Panniantong/deepseek-ops, by another author) with QR-code login; set scriptDir to its path.

items.name: dsh-plugin-update-checker
items.desc: Adds a "Check updates" tab to the Built-in plugins settings: one row per installed bundle, with its latest npm version and an update button. Each row also reports DSH-runtime compatibility. The registry is read through the .npmrc chain (environment, then profile, then user, first hit wins); with nothing configured it races a mirror against the public registry, and a private registry is never raced against a public one. A version is installed from the registry it was read from.

items.name: dsh-logcat
items.desc: Android real-device debugging workbench for the DSH Web GUI: auto-attached logcat with severity/keyword filters and crash snapshots, live on-device screen casting with remote tap/swipe/text control, memory/proc/frida reverse-engineering toolset, 30 agent tools.

items.name: dsh-portable
items.desc: Export a whole working DSH home — profile, installed plugins with their node_modules, skills, hooks and task boards — into one .dshpkg tar and import it on another machine without network or pnpm; also streams over HTTP or a one-shot LAN link.

items.name: dsh-upload-origin
items.desc: Resolves the original local path of files uploaded to .dsh-uploads by matching file name, size, and sha256.

items.name: dsh-office-com
items.desc: COM-driven real Microsoft Office automation for DeepSeek Harness: drives a running Excel/Word instance through OfficeMCP — VBA macros, pivot tables, live formula recalculation, and deep document layout; plus an accounting suite (double-entry journal posting with debit/credit balance check, and SUMIF general ledger).

items.name: dsh-ip-info
items.desc: IP/domain intelligence for DeepSeek Harness: ip_lookup, dns_lookup and whois_lookup tools via free no-key APIs (ipwho.is, Google DNS-over-HTTPS, RDAP).

items.name: dsh-lan-share
items.desc: Share the DSH workspace over the local network: phones, tablets and other computers browse, download and upload files via browser with no DSH login. Token gate, path boundary, read-only mode and rate limit. Zero-dependency (node:http).

items.name: dsh-public-apis
items.desc: The public-apis catalog wired into DeepSeek Harness: search 1716 free public APIs by keyword, category, auth, HTTPS or CORS and call any of them.

items.name: dsh-language-control
items.desc: Force the agent's chain-of-thought, planning, tool-invocation reasoning, and internal deliberation to stay in Chinese — the language constraint is injected at the top of the system prompt before every reasoning step, so it cannot be diluted by tool-returned content. A settings panel lets you edit the constraint text on the fly.

items.name: dsh-wtskin-project
items.desc: War Thunder user-skin studio: 4-point UV quad picker, quad-clipped art layers, and PNG/DDS/.blk export.

items.name: dsh-win-computer-use
items.desc: Windows-native computer use for DeepSeek Harness: two tools drive and read any desktop app. One batch call runs find, click, type, key, read, wait and screenshot steps in a single engine pass, so a task whose steps are known up front costs one model round trip; reading returns window text rather than an image, and input and capture prefer UI Automation patterns, Win32 messages and offscreen PrintWindow so the user's focus and pointer stay untouched.

items.name: specfusion
items.desc: Search 65,600+ API docs from 20 Chinese open platforms through five read-only tools and a runtime skill.

items.name: dsh-power-xc
items.desc: Power management plugin for DeepSeek Harness - sidebar power button with restart/shutdown menu, self-contained restart engine without external dependencies, graceful session flush.

items.name: dsh-time-reminder
items.desc: Gives the agent its own clock: per-session time readings whose precision the agent can change at runtime, elapsed-time counters, and one-shot countdowns that survive a host restart.

items.name: dsh-wind-aifin
items.desc: Connects seven Wind financial MCP domains and Wind Alice to DSH while resolving WIND_API_KEY only inside the host credential boundary.

items.name: dsh-capability-composer
items.desc: Composes tools, skills and MCP servers into switchable per-session sets, shrinking the resident tool surface and the system prompt on demand.

items.name: dsh-apis-plugin
items.desc: Registers any set of HTTP APIs as paired doc-query and request tools for the agent.

items.name: boardwise#dsh-plugin
items.desc: Offline schematic review for EasyEDA Pro, exposed to dsh as four tools — one-shot checkup reports, architecture skeletons, an install doctor, and a live-editor bridge that prefers read-only actions, all driven by the local boardwise CLI.

items.name: dsh-kb-manager
items.desc: Local knowledge base manager for DSH agents: multi-format import, CJK-aware chunking, sqlite-vec vector + BM25 hybrid search with bge-reranker-base rerank, snapshots, kbpack export/import and cross-KB search — 22 agent tools plus a Web panel.

items.name: dsh-image-create
items.desc: Text-to-image and image-to-image generation inside DSH through OpenAI-compatible endpoints, with an agent tool, multi-provider fallback, and a side-panel workspace with history.

items.name: computer-user-vision
items.desc: Windows computer use forked from computer-user: 13 computer_* tools that read the screen and drive the mouse and keyboard. Image-capable routes get the screenshot as a real image with an exact image-to-screen mapping, so no external OCR; elements return as UI Automation refs so a click lands on the exact control rectangle; Ctrl+Alt+Esc stops every call.

items.name: dsh-jev-verify
items.desc: 0.8.6 fixes a startup crash: the host runtime package is an optional peer, never an installed dependency. TypeSafe Jev (System One decision model) wired end to end into DeepSeek Harness (0.8.6). Seven tools: jev_decision (1-25 parallel atomic verdicts in one call; noul/choice/score; typed answers with calibrated confidence; measured median 266-484 ms; verdicts only, never prose), jev_choose (rank 2-10 candidate approaches - fit 0-3 and risk - into an explicit composite with a recommended pick), jev_batch (NEW in 0.8.6: one set of 1-5 judgments over 1-20 texts, one real call per text at bounded concurrency, returning a paste-ready markdown table sortable by a judged dimension; built-in sentiment/priority/intent/pii/spam presets; a failed row is reported as failed with the raw error, never guessed), jev_usage (locally measured usage: calls, tokens, estimated cost, latency median and p95, per-tool mix, rolling windows, projected burn rate, optional local hard budgets, and a declared-balance remainder), jev_overview (session ledger), jev_guard_status (guard counters plus a registrations block that surfaces per-surface registration failures) and jev_verify (frozen 27-question live benchmark at concurrency 6: 96.3%, 26/27). WHAT IS NEW IN 0.8.6 - the ledger survives a restart, the remainder is derived instead of invented, and the plugin can now do batch paperwork. (1) The local ledger persists to $DSH_HOME/jev-usage.json BY DEFAULT, so the cumulative total no longer resets when the host restarts. Two real bugs behind the old silent zero were found and fixed: the ledger path only honoured DSH_HOME (absent inside the host process, so persistence was silently disabled and the file name was null), and save() wrote the still-empty in-memory ring over the history file because it ran before the first load while the debounce window swallowed the follow-up write.
