(2) Remaining is derived, never invented: TypeSafe exposes no balance endpoint - /v1/usage, /v1/quota, /v1/account, /v1/account/balance, /v1/balance, /v1/credits, /v1/billing, /v1/me, /v1/limits and a dozen more all return 404, and only /v1/models answers, with no balance headers - so the panel shows the remainder as your declared balance (quota.declaredBalanceUsd) minus locally measured spend since quota.balanceSince, and says plainly that it cannot be fetched instead of printing a number. (3) The composer pill re-reads every 20 s instead of every 60 s, so a call you just made shows up while you are still looking at it. (4) The collapsed pill leads with the remainder once you declare a balance, and the cumulative row is renamed when the ledger is on disk. Every tool has an in-conversation structured view; the Settings > Plugins card covers credentials, tool switches, the auto-guard, the dashboard, the prompt section, usage/quota and auto-triage. Honest by design: no API key means an explicit error, never fabricated results; every registration is quarantined so a failure degrades one surface. Tests 38/38 (npm test, ~2.5 s). Client half applies on refresh; server half needs a host restart.

items.name: dsh-lang-guard
items.desc: Pins a Chinese (zh-CN) thinking and answering constraint into the system prompt, and registers a per-step runtime reminder so the agent does not drift back to English after tool output. Zero runtime dependencies, single file; falls back to a second registration path and only logs a warning when the host API changes.

items.name: dsh-database-explorer
items.desc: Database explorer panel for DeepSeek Harness: connect SQLite, MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, ClickHouse, Redis, Elasticsearch and Qdrant from a third Conversation tab — browse schemas, page through data, edit cells, insert rows, design and drop tables, run SQL, import/export CSV/JSON/SQL/Markdown, and draw editable E-R diagrams. Read-only connections enforce statement-level allowlists, agent tools ship read-only by default with an opt-in write flag, and every write (including refused attempts) lands in an auditable log. Ships an MCP stdio server exposing the same connections to external AI clients.

items.name: dsh-vision-hub#file-drop
items.desc: Drag-and-drop file upload for PDF, Word, Excel and images: dropped files are saved to a local directory and referenced by path, no base64 bloat in the chat.

items.name: dsh-profile-settings
items.desc: Per-profile settings overlay for DeepSeek Harness: global settings.yaml stays the baseline while each profile overrides any namespace through its own profiles/<name>/settings.patch.yml — object sections merge recursively, scalars and arrays replace wholesale, and !unset masks an inherited value. The overlay is transparent to existing plugins (they keep reading ctx.settings unchanged), writes land in the profile overlay only, and official schema validation, revision semantics, expectedRevision conflicts, watchers and events are untouched. Ships a settings command family (get/set/unset/mask/unmask/promote/demote/migrate/diff/layers) plus a Profile Settings section in the web Settings panel over a loopback RPC channel.

items.name: dsh-proxy-pro
items.desc: Routes model requests, web fetches/searches and spawned tools through the Windows system proxy or a custom address — idempotent kernel (reads never rebuild the dispatcher), header one-click toggle, per-URL route diagnosis and NTLM-aware 407 hints.

items.name: dsh-media-card
items.desc: Show local images and short videos in the DSH conversation card with one-click download of the original file, or offer any other local file for download; works over local and remote connections and keeps the media itself out of the model's vision context.

items.name: dsh-disk-browser
items.desc: Sidebar disk browser for DeepSeek Harness - browse any folder on the server (including hidden ones) with text preview, streaming download and upload (multi-select / drag-and-drop, overwrite confirm), responsive on desktop and mobile.

items.name: coderdd#dsh-rdd-explore
items.desc: Cache-first code exploration: the rdd_explore tool queries the project's .rdd/exploration index and, on a miss, dispatches a read-only worker subagent to explore and register findings; rdd_models serves the live model catalog for dispatch-time model selection.

items.name: dsh-subagent-claude-code-wrapper
items.desc: Subagent delegation provider that runs any Claude-compatible CLI binary pointed at by a configurable executablePath field.

items.name: dsh-wb
items.desc: Bridge between DSH and the local WorkBuddy desktop app, in four parts: read, search and append WorkBuddy memory, skills, plans and daily logs; run tasks through the local CodeBuddy CLI with four permission profiles; drive the running WorkBuddy window over CDP (open a conversation, read its replies as sanitized rich HTML, type and send, switch the account-billed model, relaunch it with a debug port when it is missing); and a sidebar panel that puts that conversation surface inside DSH. 25 tools and 15 HTTP routes in one plugin.

items.name: dsh-yeelight-smart-home
items.desc: Control, organize, diagnose, design, personalize, and answer product knowledge questions for a Yeelight smart home, powered by the local yeelight-home runtime.

items.name: dsh-tmp-cleaner
items.desc: Keeps the /tmp cleanup daemon alive: an in-process watchdog revives it within about two minutes after Android kills it, runs the due cleanup inside dsh while it stays down, and adds a settings page for status, config, clean and dry-run. The cleaner ships inside the package (bin/tmp-clean, Python 3), so no extra install step is needed.

items.name: dsh-mcp-matlab
items.desc: Bridges a local MATLAB MCP server into DSH: evaluate MATLAB code, run .m scripts and tests, and inspect installed toolboxes via mcp__matlab__* tools. Requires MATLAB and the MathWorks MATLAB MCP Server binary, and a path edit after install — the plugin on its own registers no tools.

items.name: dsh-mol#dsh-bundle
items.desc: Registers the dsh-mol stdio MCP server, built on RDKit with no network access, into a DSH profile. It exposes 12 tools: three-level SMILES validation with human-readable diagnostics and character positions, molecular properties, drug-likeness and structural alerts, structure rendering to PNG/SVG, multi-molecule grids, format conversion (SMILES, InChI, InChIKey, MOL, SDF, formula), standardisation with a per-step change log, deduplication, SMARTS substructure matching, fingerprint similarity, and batch clean-up that reports every rejected row. The patch only registers the server; the tools live in this repository's Python package and must be installed first — the README gives a `pip install` route and a from-source route, and until the package is on PyPI the from-source one is what works.

items.name: dsh-mol#dsh-ui
items.desc: A chemistry workbench panel in the DSH web UI. Draw structures on a Ketcher canvas (a script downloads the build; it renders locally in the browser with no backend), then compute on the current molecule with RDKit without calling a model — formula, molecular weight, exact mass, logP, TPSA, hydrogen-bond donors and acceptors, ring counts, Fsp3, stereocentres, Lipinski and Veber rule-by-rule checks, QED, PAINS/BRENK structural alerts and the Murcko scaffold, plus SMARTS substructure matching, fingerprint similarity, format conversion, standardisation and batch clean-up. A retrosynthesis tab talks to a pluggable backend (Retro* by default) over a single JSON-in/JSON-out process, and states what is missing when the backend is not installed instead of inventing a route. The calculations run in this repository's Python package (rdkit), which is installed with pip separately.

items.name: deepseek-harness-plugins#mcwiki-search
items.desc: Query Chinese Minecraft Wiki (MediaWiki API) and convert raw wiki text into clean AI-readable output — search, page intro, full-page Markdown, and random entry; templates, references, images and cross-language links are stripped before reaching the model.

items.name: dsh-bangumi
items.desc: Anime subscription manager for DeepSeek Harness: Bangumi metadata lookup, nyaa/dmhy torrent search, qBittorrent auto-download with RSS-based new-episode polling, local media-library dedup, and a calendar/progress sidebar GUI with 11 LLM tools (bangumi_lookup / bangumi_search / bangumi_subscribe / bangumi_unsubscribe / bangumi_list / bangumi_progress / bangumi_calendar / qb_status / qb_configure / qb_add_torrent / library_scan).

items.name: dsh-dingtalk-connector
items.desc: DSH plugin: read and write DingTalk AI Tables through the official dws CLI, adding ten DingTalk AI Table tools (nine `dingtalk_aitable_*` plus `dingtalk_sync_job`), a settings panel, and scheduled CSV export.

items.name: dsh-mcp-client-manager
items.desc: DSH plugin: a settings panel to list, add, rewrite and toggle @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client MCP rows — no more hand-writing them into cordis.patch.yml. Zero build, zero runtime dependencies.

items.name: dsh-siyuan
items.desc: SiYuan (思源笔记) notes integration: 17 siyuan_* host tools covering notebook and document listing, full-text search, SQL query, reading documents and blocks, creating and appending content, moving and renaming documents, daily notes and block attributes, plus a Web settings page for the SiYuan URL, API token and per-tool switches.

items.name: dsh-reference-checker
items.desc: Reference verification for DeepSeek Harness (参考文献真实性检查器): the reference_checker model tool checks a paper's bibliography (.pdf/.bib/.tex/.txt or pasted text) against Crossref, OpenAlex and arXiv, reports found / partial / not_found / error per entry, and emits corrected citations in the input's style (APA, GB/T 7714, IEEE, Vancouver, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, ACS, BibTeX).

items.name: dsh-desktop-tools
items.desc: DSH environment management: auto-installs a Rust/Tauri desktop host (downloaded per-OS from dsh-desktop-host releases, source build as fallback), one-click runtime updates, Windows platform compatibility, official DeepSeek billing, and a built-in code editor for the workspace.

items.name: dsh-tool-archive
items.desc: Pack a directory into a deterministic tar, read an archive's contents without extracting it, unpack while refusing every member that could reach outside the destination, and verify what came out against what went in by SHA-256. No external dependency — the tar format is written and read in this plugin. Extraction is deliberately more permissive on reading than on writing, because a reader's job is to report what an archive says, while a writer must never emit what it cannot read back. A tar has no central index, so the walk tracks whether it reached the end-of-archive marker: without that, a half-file checksums fine and reads as complete.

items.name: dsh-tool-browser
items.desc: Open a page, wait for it the way it actually needs, extract the readable article, and take a screenshot. Playwright is optional: when it is absent the tools fall back to a static fetch and say so in the result, because a page whose JavaScript never ran means something different from one that rendered. Content is chosen by scoring candidate subtrees on prose density rather than on tag names, so a container loses to the article inside it instead of winning by containing more of the document.

items.name: dsh-tool-comfyui
items.desc: Generate images from chat by calling a fleet of local or LAN ComfyUI workers, with workflow templates, worker health checks and queue control.

items.name: dsh-tool-epub
items.desc: Read, build and take apart EPUB 3 books with no external dependency — the ZIP reader/writer and the XML scanner are both built in. Inspect metadata, reading order and TOC for structural problems, assemble a book from chapters, or split one back into per-chapter HTML.

items.name: dsh-tool-gzh-publisher
items.desc: WeChat Official Account pipeline: validate a draft against a publish gate, then push it into the draft box.

items.name: dsh-tool-invoice
items.desc: Pull invoice number, date, parties, tax IDs and the amount/tax/total triplet out of text, then verify that amount plus tax really equals the total and flag documents that do not reconcile.

items.name: dsh-tool-media
items.desc: Drive a local ffmpeg as six structured tools: probe a file's streams, transcode or trim it, pull evenly-spaced frames or the audio track, and compress video to a byte budget with two-pass encoding.

items.name: dsh-tool-mining
items.desc: Turn a GitHub repository's raw counts into a defensible judgement — contributor concentration and bus factor with single-author files, merge time reported as a median beside the mean so an outlier is visible rather than hidden, and an issue backlog with pull requests and drafts filtered out. Reads the public REST API with no SDK, and never claims a truncated page is the whole answer.

items.name: dsh-tool-notion
items.desc: Convert Notion blocks and Markdown in both directions, with no API client and no external dependency. A Notion paragraph is an array of rich-text runs while Markdown says one string, so the two directions are a split and a merge rather than a pair of inverses — rich-text runs are cut at every annotation boundary one way and re-merged the other, with fences widened when the content already contains backticks. Reports every lossy step instead of swallowing it.

items.name: dsh-tool-ocr
items.desc: Extract text from an image or PDF, reading a born-digital text layer directly and falling through to a configured OCR engine for scans.

items.name: dsh-tool-podcast
items.desc: Turn a raw recording into a published podcast with a local ffmpeg — detect chapter boundaries from silence, cut at those boundaries, normalise loudness to a broadcast target in two passes, and write an iTunes-compatible RSS feed whose enclosure byte lengths are measured from disk.

items.name: dsh-tool-protobuf
items.desc: Read, audit and diff Protocol Buffer definitions without installing protoc: a zero-dependency .proto parser exposing six tools (status, outline, describe, diff, audit, next_number). diff classifies every change as breaking, risky or additive and names the wire-format consequence; audit catches what protoc accepts but a reviewer should not — duplicated or illegal field numbers, reserved-range collisions, unresolved types, and unreserved gaps below the high-water mark.

items.name: dsh-tool-qrcode
items.desc: Generate QR codes from a from-scratch ISO/IEC 18004 encoder with no external tools, plan symbol version and error-correction headroom before producing anything, and decode an existing symbol back to text.

items.name: dsh-tool-subtitle
items.desc: Read, write, convert and retime a subtitle track across SRT, WebVTT and ASS, audit it for over-long or unreadable cues, and transcribe audio through a configured speech recogniser.

items.name: dsh-closet
items.desc: Per-workspace closet for temporary scripts and their run logs, kept in a .dsh-fix directory inside each project. Registers a script with its language and purpose, scans a project for leftover scratch scripts, backups and log files, runs registered scripts with a timeout and writes each run to a timestamped log, and sweeps chosen files into a reversible trash with per-batch restore. Scanning only lists and never deletes; cleanup moves files instead of deleting them; files already tracked by git are refused unless forced. Ships 7 agent tools and a settings panel.

items.name: dsh-conversation-nav-dots
items.desc: Navigation dots for DSH Web conversations — quickly jump between user messages.

items.name: dsh-prompt-system
items.desc: Prompt optimizer in the composer: rewrites the draft into an eleven-section analytical prompt using the conversation, workspace files and the session's selected model, with one-click undo.

items.name: dsh-web-search-litellm
items.desc: Web search provider for the ctx.web seam that routes the DeepSeek web_search tool through a LiteLLM proxy using the OpenAI Responses API, reusing LITELLM_API_KEY.

items.name: dsh-overall-mcp
items.desc: Host-wide MCP server panel: imports the servers declared in Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor and Codex CLI configs, searches six upstream catalogs and installs from whichever of them declares an install plan, asks only for the fields a server actually declares, and checks each row for whether the mount, the handshake and its tool list really work.

items.name: dsh-user-addons
items.desc: Drag-and-drop file upload into the conversation composer, token usage pill with quota tracking, and session archive management — a three-in-one daily-driver addon.

items.name: dsh-pdf-mineru
items.desc: Provider-independent DSH document parsing powered by MinerU, with native background jobs, immutable results, and safe request coalescing.

items.name: dsh-web-search-enhanced
items.desc: Web search with Exa, Firecrawl, Tavily and Tinyfish, per-session search connection and freshness preferences, and a chat-toolbar selector.

items.name: dsh-webui-launcher
items.desc: Cross-platform Web UI launcher for DeepSeek Harness: webui_start/stop/status/open model tools, a /webui start|stop|status|open slash command, a Settings-page launch card, and an optional desktop shortcut that starts the Web UI hidden and opens the browser once it is fully ready (dsh default icon).

items.name: multisim-mcp#deepseek-harness
items.desc: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Multisim MCP for circuit generation, simulation, diagnostics, design optimization, and experiment report export.

items.name: dsh-table-attach
items.desc: Attach tables and documents (xlsx, csv, pdf, zip…) to the DSH composer via paste or drag-and-drop: files are saved into the session workspace and an @reference is inserted.

items.name: dsh-gpt-image
items.desc: Game asset production pipeline: generate images, video and audio, turn a video into a coherent sprite animation, derive recoloured variants, adapt assets to an engine schema, install them into the project and verify the code actually references them. Requires ffmpeg for the video-to-sprite path, and an image/video API key (Agnes AI / OpenAI / fal) for generation.

items.name: dsh-algo-trainer
items.desc: Algorithm learning toolkit syncing Codeforces and AtCoder submissions, profiling weaknesses, generating AI training plans, and tracking spaced-repetition reviews across a 114-lesson algorithm curriculum.

items.name: sci-fork
items.desc: A biomedical Research Graph grounded in literature and experiment results. Fork hypotheses, connect evidence, advance research.

items.name: dsh-claude-code
items.desc: Delegates a self-contained coding task to the local Claude Code subscription through the official Claude Agent SDK, and adds a session tab with live output, cost and remaining quota.

items.name: dsh-lazy-mcp
items.desc: MCP gateway for dsh that connects each server on first use and disconnects it after an idle window; tool lists are cached on disk, existing mcpServers files can be imported, and child-process environment variables are scrubbed.

items.name: dsh-cubox
items.desc: Cubox sync for DeepSeek Harness: scheduled sync of your bookmarks, an AI daily brief generated from your own prompt template straight into Obsidian, and per-card markdown export.

items.name: dsh-zhihu
items.desc: Zhihu (知乎) for DeepSeek Harness: wraps the local pyzhihu-cli as 18 zhihu_* tools — 14 read-only (search, hot list, question, answer, user, feed, topic, notifications, collections) plus 4 publishing tools that are not registered until readOnly is turned off — with a web panel in the sidebar for login, config and lookups.

items.name: weread-export
items.desc: WeChat Reading (WeRead) multi-target export for DeepSeek Harness via the official Skills API gateway: browse your bookshelf, export highlights & thoughts to flomo, a local Markdown file, or Notion, optionally reworked by a configurable LLM prompt.

items.name: dsh-anysearch
items.desc: AnySearch-backed search tools for agents: general and vertical-domain search, parallel batch queries, vertical-domain capability discovery, and page-to-Markdown extraction, plus an API key panel in Settings. It registers its own tools instead of a web_search provider, so it cannot be installed alongside @anysearch/anysearch-dsh.

items.name: dsh-plugin-agnes-image
items.desc: Adds an agnes_image tool that calls the Agnes Image Flash models (2.5, 2.1, 2.0) for text-to-image, image-to-image and multi-image composition, and ships a settings-page console for the active model, default size and aspect ratio, output folder, API key and generation history.

items.name: dsh-go-sensei
items.desc: Go (weiqi) review coach: parses SGF records, backfills winrate and score analysis with a bundled KataGo engine, explains the costly moves in the chat, and writes the commentary back into an SGF copy; a web panel shows the board with problem moves, AI choices and variations.

items.name: dsh-deepseek-model-router
items.desc: Auto-switch DeepSeek models: routes every request to the vision model when images are present, to the pro model for complex tasks, and to the fast model otherwise; includes a switch_model tool for manual overrides.

items.name: dsh-deepseek-billing-period
items.desc: DeepSeek API billing-period chip in the composer dock: shows whether the current time is peak or off-peak with a countdown to the next rate switch, opens the peak/off-peak window rules on click, and during peak hours intercepts sending to ask for confirmation first.

items.name: dsh-keep-awake
items.desc: Keeps the DSH host awake during active tasks using native power assertions and releases them when tasks finish.

items.name: bazidiy#ontology
items.desc: BaziDIY ontology plugin: deterministic bazi/wuxing/bead/style rules as DSH tools (calculate_bazi, propose_designs, generate_design, save_design, load_design), plus bracelet SVG rendering and a bead editor; no LLM calls inside execute.

items.name: dsh-atom-market
items.desc: Software Atom Market for DeepSeek Harness - lets agents browse a shared store of contract-typed capability atoms: search atoms, read full manifests, validate submissions, draft new atoms (atom_search/atom_read/atom_validate/atom_draft); GitHub store as zero-config default source.

items.name: dsh-milvus
items.desc: Read-only DSH Web plugin for inspecting and searching Milvus or Zilliz Cloud collections from chat, including scalar, BM25, dense, and hybrid queries.

items.name: dsh-valuation-service
items.desc: Registers one `valuation_service` tool that reads a workpaper tree of 01/02/04 JSON and returns one unified schema: six ratio groups, forecast ratios, DCF input slots with explicit missing markers, comparable PS/PE and IRR. Deterministic and local: missing WACC, growth, capex, D&A or working-capital inputs stay blank instead of being guessed, and assumption differences are flagged for review.

items.name: dsh-mcp-control
items.desc: Settings panel for MCP servers registered by @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client: toggle each server on or off with live effect, see the registered tool count and estimated context-token cost of each server, and persist the choice to the home cordis.patch.yml with a timestamped backup before every write. Maintained fork of dsh-mcp-toggle.

items.name: dsh-frecency
items.desc: Resident-index grep for DeepSeek Harness that shadows the built-in grep/glob tools under the same names: repeated content searches hit an in-memory index ranked by access/modification frecency, and glob serves the built-in ripgrep semantics when available, falling back to the index otherwise.

items.name: dsh-web-search-multi
items.desc: Selectable SearXNG, Brave, Tavily, Gemini Search Grounding, or Wikipedia backend for the native web_search tool, with Web settings and no implicit fallback.

items.name: dsh-browser-use
items.desc: Browser Use cloud bridge for dsh: run real web tasks — open pages, click, type, fill forms, and extract data — through the Browser Use API.

items.name: dsh-firecrawl
items.desc: Scrape URLs to LLM-ready Markdown and search the web via the Firecrawl Cloud API.

items.name: dsh-behavior-enhancer
items.desc: Tool-call discipline for DeepSeek Harness: injects a static behavior-constraint prompt section, drops the parallel pool to 1 after a tool failure (restoring after 3 consecutive successes), nudges the model to stop retrying after repeated failures, verifies writes with .bak rollback, gates high-risk commands, and tracks compliance stats via /behavior-status.

items.name: dsh-agnes-tools
items.desc: Agnes AI image and video generation tools for DeepSeek Harness, where long video jobs can be resumed in a later call. Requires an Agnes API key (AGNES_API_KEY).

items.name: dsh-auto-retry
items.desc: Adds supplemental request retries, turn auto-continue and a no-response watchdog on top of built-in dsh retries, with a live countdown banner, toast notifications and a usage dashboard.

items.name: vision-use
items.desc: Desktop computer-use for DSH: captures the Windows screen into the agent vision channel and drives mouse/keyboard through a Codex-style overlay with Esc abort; auto-detects Windows native or WSL hosts.
